name: BetteRose Ryan

summary.text: BetteRose Ryan has a bachelor's degree in mathematics with an emphasis on secondary education. She is a former teacher in the Brush and Sterling, Colorado area and a retired U.S. Army sergeant.

experience.text: Teacher in the Brush and Sterling, Colorado area.
Served in the U.S. Army; retired as a sergeant.

education_focus.text: Ryan says she wants college 'to become more affordable without compromising good education' and wants money 'spent well.'
On AI, she says it is 'just another tool' and that students and teachers will need to adjust to it much as they did to calculators.
On affordability, she says CU should 'dig deeper into the budget' and 'find ways to cut things that don’t add to the education of our students.'

positions.source_title: Voter guide: CU Board of Regents candidates on tuition, AI, and federal oversight (Chalkbeat Colorado)
positions.quote: I believe that if the policy is reasonable for our system, we commit. If it is unreasonable, we reject it and figure out how to survive without federal assistance.
positions.note: Answer to Chalkbeat's question on whether she would commit CU to the Trump administration's priorities. An explicitly case-by-case stance, coded as mixed; she does not mention the state's lawsuits, so this is inferred.
